caption: "Hmmm ... a bit dry"

caption: First prize in the delicate flower show. Early convalescence was really hard but I only cried a little.

caption: Fat girl dungarees on a less fat girl

caption: "I think I'm just going to sit down"
alt: Collage showing a figure standing beside a hospital bed surrounded by grey and black shapes.

caption: My consultant with the hair-stroking energy and understatement: "We're very pleased you came in when you did."

caption: "We don't need to talk, I just want to know that you're safe"
alt: Collage showing a visitor seated beside a hospital bed with a patient arm visible.

caption: Naked again! Reprimanded for taking my gown off in my sleep – because there are male nurses! Temperature raging!

caption: Ninja Nurse

caption: When you leave the party with a goody bag – NHS style
alt: Collage showing a pharmacy bag, medication boxes and pill blister packs.

caption: In my pirate era – no one told me all my hair would fall out. No me gusta!

alt: Collage showing a figure beside a hospital bed with two surgical drains hanging from the body on long tubes.

caption: Weights + Measures according to my radiologist: 1 psoas abscess = 1 satsuma; 1 abscess fluid extraction = a shot of whisky ... no! ... a proper (Scottish) shot ... no ... an espresso!
alt: Collage showing several satsumas with leaves against a blue background.

caption: The shitscapades! I fell trying to reach the walker because I didn't know I couldn't stand. I got such a telling off – because sliding around in your own excrement apparently isn't enough!
alt: Collage showing a figure falling near a hospital bed, with a knocked over walker and faeces on the floor.

caption: I didn't choose the Staph life, the Staph life chose me.

alt: Collage showing a patient in a hospital, their belly rolls are on display and marked with two blue dots.

alt: Collage showing a hand reaching through grapes on a tray table, with a T-SQL textbook partly hidden underneath.

alt: Collage showing a patient walking down a hospital corridor, wearing a hospital gown and carrying their clothes in a red bag.
